question: Should maintainers accept the centralized core queue-owner boundary for live and recovered cross-channel delivery after an up-to-date rebase and merge-head validation?
rationale: The change intentionally concentrates acknowledgement and failure ownership in a delivery-critical core path, and the protected maintainer label requires an explicit owner decision beyond automated review.

options.title: Approve after refresh
options.body: Rebase onto current main and land if the exact merge head preserves the claim-fenced recovery and channel-delivery evidence.

options.title: Request a narrower split
options.body: Keep adapter cleanup separate and ask for a smaller core queue-owner change if maintainers prefer a more incremental ownership migration.
